File No. **〔此处转录不清〕**
S.1, Special Branch **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date January 7, 1938.

Subject (in full) "China Group to Resist Japan and Exterminate Traitors"

Made by D.J.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Gaspard

Continued enquiries have been carried out in an
effort to trace the source of the handbill and the premises
where this Group is operating from, but without obtaining
any results. No arrests have been made of people with those
handbills and no further handbills have been distributed
lately.

（批：Die
Jan 7）

Kao Yen-ken
D. J. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.B
- 7 JAN 1938
SPECIAL BRANCH）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
S.I, Special Branch XXXXXX
REPORT
Date November 16, 19 37.

Subject Handbill on Chekiang Road.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Gaus [signature]

A mimeographed copy of a handbill (attached)
purporting to emanate from a "China Group to Resist Japan
and Exterminate Traitors" (中國抗日除奸團) was
found pasted on the door of 75 Chekiang Road on November 14.
The handbill advocates the arming of the masses
to resist the Japanese Imperialists to the bitter end. At
the end of the handbill, the following slogans appear :
1. Organize the masses and arm them to defend the Greater
Shanghai and the whole of China !
2. Down with Japanese Imperialism !
3. Execute Chinese traitors !
4. Kill all traitorous merchants who sell the interests
of the nation and deal in Japanese goods !
5. Support the Government in the war of resistance to the
bitter end !
6. Long live the Republic of China !
7. Work for the victory of the emancipation of the Chinese
race !

According to records, this organization has never
come to the notice of the Special Branch.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

(Special Branch).    DC (Dir)
Under the circumstances it is
proposed to try & make an
arrest.

S.I.
Cao

（左侧页边批注及印章）：
Noted
Dir
P.A.
Try & track
them down
（印：SPECIAL 16 NOV 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
D.S.R.
SO. A
D.O. B L
Sep 6
+ CPC
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (DIVISIONAL)）

S.I，特别处 XXXXXX
报告
日期：1937年11月16日。

主题：浙江路发现的传单。

制作人：高级督察级警员 高延根（Kao Yen-ken） 转呈人：C. Gaus [签名]

11月14日，在浙江路75号的门上发现张贴着一份油印传单（附后），声称出自“中国抗日除奸团”（中國抗日除奸團）。该传单号召武装民众，坚决抵抗日本帝国主义。传单末尾列有以下口号：
1. 组织民众并武装他们，保卫大上海及全中国！
2. 打倒日本帝国主义！
3. 处决汉奸！
4. 诛杀所有出卖国家利益、贩卖日货的奸商！
5. 支持政府抗战到底！
6. 中华民国万岁！
7. 为实现中华民族解放的胜利而奋斗！

据记录，特别处此前从未注意到该组织的存在。

高延根（Kao Yen-ken）
高级督察级警员 (D. S. I.)

（特别处）。    副总监（主管）
鉴于上述情况，
建议尝试进行
逮捕。

高级督察级警员
曹

（左侧页边批注及印章）：
已知悉
主管
助理局长
尝试追踪
其下落
（印章：特别处 1937年11月16日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
D.S.R.
SO. A
D.O. B L
9月6日
+ 中国共产党
（印章：分区副总监）

（右下侧印章）：
（印章：特别处 1937年11月16日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
